as_of_rule: Last finished UTC day. The in-progress UTC day is excluded until 00:00 UTC. This run's UTC date was 2026-11-09.

quantile_method.formula: band = sth_realized_price on the as-of day × linear percentile of sth_mvrv, position (n-1)*q
quantile_method.window: Every finite day1 sth_mvrv print from the first valid day through the as-of date. Later days are excluded, so this is an expanding window with no backfill. The current band is the full finished history through that day. The 2026-09-24 sanity block uses only days on or before 2026-09-24.
quantile_method.range_filter: 0.05 < sth_mvrv < 10. The live history sits inside that range, so the sample is the full series.
quantile_method.q90_meaning: Only about 10% of days in the sample were higher.
quantile_method.fallback: bull_levels.json sth_q75_fallback 87000 and sth_q90_fallback 104000 when this calc is unavailable.

sth_q75.note: That day's short-term holder realized price times the point-in-time Q75 of historical sth_mvrv. Q90 means only about 10% of days the indicator was higher. Check's model overheats several times in a bull (local tops).

sth_q90.note: That day's short-term holder realized price times the point-in-time Q90 of historical sth_mvrv. Q90 means only about 10% of days the indicator was higher. Check's model overheats several times in a bull (local tops).

urpd_poc.note: Live proxy (URPD POC), not Check MRI. Point of control of Bitview's all-cohort cost-basis distribution in $1k bins above $10k.

mri_q50.note: CheckOnChain Mean Reversion Index bands, Q50 trace. Live Check series. bull_levels.json mri_midpoint is the fallback only.

check_q50_proxy.note: Live proxy for Check Q50: Bitview STH cost-basis 75th percentile. Not Check's published number.

band_history.format: {t,v} with t = unix seconds at UTC midnight, v = USD. Same shape as checkonchain_overlays.json.
band_history.note: Each point is that day's sth_realized_price times the expanding-window Q75 or Q90 of sth_mvrv through that day. Later days are not included. sth_q75 and sth_q90 stay the latest finished values for the card.

sanity_2026_09_24.expected: Q75 near $87–88k and Q90 near $104k (about 1.17× and 1.40× short-term holder cost basis). Small drift is expected.
sanity_2026_09_24.drift_note: Bitview short-term holders are under 150 days. Check's bands use about 155 days, so the multiple and the dollar band can sit a little off the published anchors.

sth_cost_basis_cluster.note: Where recent buyers bought. Supply here turns underwater on a dip. Not a target.

mayer_1_5.note: Computed as 1.5 × Bitview price_sma_200d. Search for a Mayer series returned nothing.

lth_supply_share.warning_rule: Steady decline: 90-day change in the supply share is at least 1 percentage point lower.

history_1y.format: {t,v} unix UTC midnight seconds. Last 365 finished days through as_of.

method.day_rule: Last finished UTC day. The in-progress UTC day is dropped. One point per date.
method.funding: Funding Rate (+ve) and Funding Rate (-ve) combined. The quiet side is 0. Averages are the last 7 and 30 finished observations.
method.oi: 7-calendar-day percent change in Futures OI from leverageratio_0: (OI today − OI 7 days earlier) / OI 7 days earlier. The ±2sd band is that series' trailing 365 observations, mean ± sd-multiple × sample standard deviation (n−1). The Check chart derivatives_futuresoi_1daychange trace 'Futures OI 1-day Change (%)' matches this 7-calendar-day change, not the 1-calendar-day change. Warning when the 7-day change is above the +2sd band. Below −2sd is info only (Leverage flush).
method.lev_ratio: Watch when the 30-day change is at least the configured percentage points and the ratio is at least that many percentage points above its trailing-365-day low. Warning when the ratio itself is at or above the configured level.

leverage.note: Leverage: building. A watch is on. The Top signals panel stays closed unless a warning is also on.

series_used.role: Short-term holder cost basis, and the base of the Q75/Q90 profit-taking bands
STH-MVRV level, and the full history behind the Q75/Q90 profit-taking bands
Cost-basis cluster P75. Where recent buyers bought. Not a target.
Cost-basis cluster P90. Where recent buyers bought. Not a target.
Total supply, denominator for the LTH share

series_not_found.note: No Mayer multiple series. The dollar level is 1.5 × price_sma_200d. price_sma_200d_x2_4 exists and was not used (that is 2.4×).

series_not_found.query: futures open interest / perpetual funding on Bitview
series_not_found.note: Not on Bitview. The leverage block uses CheckOnChain public derivatives charts instead.

notes: Refreshed by refresh_bull_watch.py. Do not invent prints.
Chart True Mean and STH cost basis overlays stay on the CheckOnChain file. This feed is the bull-card live layer.
STH Q75/Q90 are profit-taking bands: that day's sth_realized_price times a point-in-time expanding-window quantile of historical sth_mvrv. Not the cost-basis percentiles.
sth_q75_history and sth_q90_history are the daily curves for the chart. The sth_q75 and sth_q90 objects remain the latest values for the card.
sth_cost_basis_per_coin_pct75/pct90 are the cost-basis cluster in the secondary panel. They are where recent buyers bought, not targets.
If the quantile calc is unavailable, the app falls back to static 87000 / 104000 in bull_levels.json.
Leverage is the CheckOnChain derivatives block. Thresholds live in bull_levels.json under leverage. The in-progress UTC day is dropped.
